thread:
incidentbot: ALERT: High 5xx rate detected in inference-gateway (prod-usw2). Error-rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~8% over the last 3m. Auto-created PagerDuty incident INC-8796.

elaine.sre: ack — I'm on it, moving to this channel. pinging infra and deploy owners.

raj.platform: I see the majority of 502s coming from auth-proxy upstreams, some kv-cache timeouts too. pulling recent proxy logs now.

mike.prod: customers are reporting failures on text-gen /v1/generate. Do we need a status page message?

sophie-eng: quick timeline: a rolling canary deploy for runtime image 2.4.0 started ~2026-03-17T10:12Z in us-west2. Could be correlated. Checking deploy logs.

raj.platform: running command to tail proxy errors:
```
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=ingress-proxy -c proxy --since=5m | grep -i "502\|handshake" | head -n 80
```

elaine.sre: logs show TLS handshake errors + upstream 502s around 10:12. Hypothesis: connection keepalive defaults changed, causing connection churn under burst. Will try rolling restart of proxy nodes as a quick mitigation.

sophie-eng: confirmed: image 2.4.0 changed keepalive default 30s -> 5s. That explains higher churn. Revert to 2.3.9 is safest.

raj.platform: initiating rolling restart of proxy pods (stagger 20s).

pagerduty: PagerDuty INC-8796 acknowledged by elaine.sre at 2026-03-17T10:16:40Z.

mike.prod: do we have a list of affected customers? preliminary: embed-api + text-gen customers route-heavy. I'll prepare a short status blurb to publish if impact persists.

elaine.sre: restart progress: restarted 3/5 proxy nodes. partial drop in 5xx to ~3.2% in us-west2. continuing.

sophie-eng: canary logs show 2.4.0's keepalive change came from https://git.redwood/runbooks/commit/ab12cd — rolling back canary to 2.3.9 now.

mike.prod: status blurb draft: "We are investigating increased 5xx on inference endpoints. Mitigation underway; some customers may see intermittent errors. Will update shortly." Need :thumbsup: for publish.

raj.platform: after rollback triggered, 5xx fell to ~0.9% in us-west2. Looks promising.

sophie-eng: canary rollback complete. Kicking full rollout revert with 30s splay.

elaine.sre: monitoring global error rate and customer-facing metrics. If stable for 10m we'll resolve. Opening postmortem ticket PM-112 for follow-up.

mike.prod: posted status update on status.redwood.com (draft -> live). Notified affected customers via comms channel.

raj.platform: global 5xx baseline restored to ~0.15% now. No signs of downstream data loss.

elaine.sre: marking incident as resolved from our side. Will compile timeline and root cause: runtime image 2.4.0 keepalive regression -> proxy churn -> upstream 502s.

pagerduty: PagerDuty INC-8796 resolved by elaine.sre at 2026-03-17T10:34:12Z. Follow-up: PM-112 (postmortem) assigned.

sophie-eng: follow-up action items: 1) add pre-deploy connection regression test for runtime images, 2) tighten canary monitoring thresholds, 3) postmortem in next SRE sync.

mike.prod: thanks all — good catch and fast rollback. I'll sync comms with CS. :thumbsup:
